ValidationRule.description: Check if the coverage lies under the range of 5 x 5, only allow the override ratings to be checked if it is in that range.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(Policy__r.Limit__r.Is_5X5_Coverage__c = false, RecordType.DeveloperName <> 'CC_Change_Coverage_Transaction', Override_Rating__c = true, NOT(ISNULL(Override_5_5__c)))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: The Policy Coverage does not lie in the 5 x 5 range!
